title: Fire & Wildlife Watch
subtitle: Satellite VIIRS thermal hotspots, burn scars, and wildlife corridor fragmentation in Kudremukh
whatThisMeansTitle: What This Means for Field Teams
whatThisMeansText: Thermal hotspots denote high-temperature surface anomalies detected by VIIRS sensors. High-risk wildlife corridors overlap with active thermal detections or steep terrain edges, demanding immediate patrol deployment before tree canopy degradation turns irreversible.
